steps.title: Open Trendora
steps.narration: Trendora opens on the Dashboard, its home for today's market status and stock rankings.
steps.point_out: A status banner near the top says plainly whether today's data is fully fresh, rather than staying quiet about it.

steps.title: Browse the stock rankings
steps.narration: The Stocks page lists ranked tickers with real, evidence-checked scores. This round, the team confirmed pages like this one load quickly, pulling only the data they actually need.
steps.point_out: The list appears fully populated right away — confirmed this round to hold up even during heavier background work elsewhere in the app.

steps.title: Open the evidence ledger
steps.narration: The Evidence page is Trendora's certified-claims ledger, where a pattern only counts as proven once it has survived independent testing.
steps.point_out: Nothing here gets called confident without real evidence behind it.

steps.title: Open the Data Manager
steps.narration: Behind the scenes, an operator uses the Data Manager to backfill historical data and watch ingest jobs run.
steps.point_out: The coverage panel shows exactly what's already stored before anything new is requested.

steps.title: Request a small backfill
steps.narration: Let's ask for just two days of data.
steps.point_out: The start date is set to 2026-05-02.

steps.title: Set the end date
steps.narration: One day later closes out the range.
steps.point_out: The end date is set to 2026-05-03.

steps.title: See the honest zero-work result
steps.narration: Those two days turn out to be already fully covered, mostly non-trading days, so Trendora says so plainly instead of pretending to do work.
steps.point_out: The result explains there are no new snapshots, rather than staying silent or claiming success with no explanation.

steps.title: Request a much wider backfill
steps.narration: Now let's ask for something bigger: over a year of history in a single request.
steps.point_out: The start date is set to 2025-06-01.

steps.title: Set the wide end date
steps.narration: The range stretches all the way to 2026-07-17.
steps.point_out: The end date is set to 2026-07-17.

steps.title: Submit the wide request
steps.narration: Clicking Start sends the whole range in one go.
steps.point_out: There's no prompt to split it into smaller pieces.

steps.title: See the full range accepted
steps.narration: Trendora accepts the entire request and reports exactly how much ground it covers.
steps.point_out: 412 calendar days, accepted in a single request, with no artificial per-run limit.

steps.title: Revisit a stored day
steps.narration: Let's open one specific day that was already scanned a while back.
steps.point_out: It's labeled an immutable snapshot: stored exactly as scanned, never recalculated for today.

steps.title: Check the backtest evidence
steps.narration: The Backtest page never runs a fresh calculation while you wait — it only ever shows evidence that was already prepared in advance.
steps.point_out: The evidence shown is always a specific, dated version — current, or a clearly labeled still-good version, but never a live guess.

steps.title: Confirm the app stays healthy under heavy background work
steps.narration: This round, the team also confirmed something reassuring: even while a slow calculation runs in the background, Trendora keeps answering normally the whole time — nothing freezes, nothing goes down.
steps.point_out: The status badge stays green and 'Ready' — measured this round to hold steady for the entire background-calculation window, with every page and the health check answering throughout.
